contents.text: The case already belongs to our department, order-service, so there's no need to sort it first. The runbook marks KeyNotFoundException from retired code as auto-fixable, but that isn't expected here, so I'll investigate before attempting any auto-fix. I'm briefing the investigator first.

arguments.message:
Run id: eval-order-total-1003. Please investigate this error from the order-service (repository: demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service in the workspace).

Error: method order-total, argument 1003, System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException, "The given key 'SUMMER25' was not present in the dictionary." Stack: Dictionary.get_Item called from OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs:line 18, called from src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 13 and 45.

Runbook for order-total: GET /orders/{id}/total = subtotal minus the order's discount code, rounded to 2 decimals (Api/OrderTotal.cs). Discount codes in force: WELCOME10 (10%), VIP20 (20%). Marketing retires codes without notice, so orders can carry a code no longer in the table. Expected only: OrderNotFoundException (404). Auto-fixable: any other exception, e.g. KeyNotFoundException for a retired discount code. Expected behaviour: an unknown or retired discount code gives no discount (total = subtotal) instead of failing. Totals for orders with WELCOME10, VIP20 or no code must not change.

Please find where the cause is, what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code/data/hosting/third-party/unknown) and your confidence, then end with ReportInvestigation.
